title: Fibers, Image, and Nonproperness of the Counterexample
statement: The nonproperness hypersurface is the cubic discriminant, its singular/omitted locus is a cusp-type curve C1, and the fibers have the described 3/1/0 pattern.

members.title: Generic degree and fiber stratification of the counterexample
members.statement: The Alpöge map has generic degree 3, with affine fiber cardinality 3 off the cubic discriminant, 1 on the discriminant away from the triple-root curve, and 0 on the triple-root curve.

members.title: Image and nonproperness set of the counterexample
members.statement: The image of the Alpöge map is complex affine 3-space minus the triple-root curve Gamma, while its nonproperness set is the discriminant hypersurface V(Delta).

members.title: Invertibility and properness for complex Keller maps
members.statement: For a Keller map over the complex numbers, polynomial invertibility, properness, emptiness of the nonproperness set, and codimension at least 2 of that set are equivalent, with the empty set assigned infinite codimension.
